source: Unidata NEXRAD Level II completed volumes and NWS active Tornado Warning polygons
label_policy: Heuristic couplets are not tornado or debris ground truth. A qualified human must review raw moments, beam geometry, warning evolution, and independent reports before assigning training labels.
retention_note: The recorded JSONL includes source volume keys but not the raw Level II bytes or full warning-polygon GeoJSON. Preserve the JSONL and deduplication state; retrieve source volumes and warning records by their keys/IDs for future review.
